name: A Noble Brew
summary: Zardeth of the Black Claw schemes against Stormwind's nobles from beneath the Slaughtered Lamb. Lord Wishock's call for an investigation puts the hidden warlock coven at risk.

sections.title: Threat from the Nobility
sections.body: Beneath the Mage Quarter streets, warlocks gather in the Slaughtered Lamb and keep their coven hidden. Lord Wishock, a member of the House of Nobles, has heard of the dark magic below the city. He is urging his peers to launch a full investigation, which could bring the city guard and royal scrutiny down on the coven.

sections.title: A Concoction in the Shadows
sections.body: To avoid an open clash with Stormwind's ruling class, Zardeth of the Black Claw seeks a quiet remedy to keep Lord Wishock occupied. The brew calls for rare plants from distant parts of the Eastern Kingdoms: the pale Tear of Tilloa from Duskwood, and a Musquash Root gathered underwater beneath the Stonewrought Dam.

faq.answer: Lord Wishock is a nobleman in Stormwind's House of Nobles. After hearing hints of warlock activity beneath the Mage Quarter, he began pressing the council to open a formal investigation.

faq.q: Who is Zardeth of the Black Claw?
faq.answer: Zardeth is a senior warlock in the crypts beneath Stormwind's Slaughtered Lamb. He works to shield the city's warlock cabal from discovery and a purge by the authorities.

faq.q: Where does the Tear of Tilloa come from?
faq.answer: The Tear of Tilloa is a delicate white flower found in the overgrown Garden of Stalvan, on the outskirts of Darkshire in Duskwood.

faq.q: Where is the Musquash Root found?
faq.answer: The Musquash Root grows only in the wetlands at the very base of the massive waterfalls beneath the Stonewrought Dam in the Wetlands.

faq.q: Why doesn't Stormwind's government already know about the warlocks?
faq.answer: Warlocks are deeply distrusted in Stormwind, so the coven beneath the Slaughtered Lamb hides its practice underground, away from the city guards and nobles. Lord Wishock has only just caught wind of it.

faq.q: What does Zardeth intend to brew with these reagents?
faq.answer: Zardeth says the brew will keep Lord Wishock occupied and stall the investigation. What he intends for the nobleman becomes clear only when the brew is ready.

angles.text: As a warlock, the crypts beneath the Slaughtered Lamb are your safe haven in Stormwind. Helping Zardeth protects your brothers and sisters in the dark arts from discovery by the kingdom's righteous nobility.
While King Varian Wrynn remains missing, political maneuvering in the House of Nobles is at an all-time high. That makes scandals within the city especially dangerous to its stability.
As a herbalist, you know the Tear of Tilloa and Musquash Root are rare plants that grow only in regions shaped by grim history or torrents of pristine water.
